description: The Dassault Mirage IIIEA is single-seat fighter, intercepter, and strike aircraft. The EA version was specifically built for the Argentine air force.
loadnotes: Turns limited to HT/TT if more than 2600/1300 lb carried on either of stations 2 or 4.
May carry two BBs or DRs on station 3.
May carry Matra R.550 Magic IRMs on stations 1 and 5
May carry Matra R.530 RHMs on station 3.
May carry 1300L FTs on station 2, 3, and 4 and 1700L FTs on stations 2 and 4.
No supersonic flight while carrying FTs.
